To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the word fun is used to describe a wide range of experiences that are not necessarily pleasurable and that the word pleasure is used to describe experiences that are pleasurable.
• Fun is an experience that can be defined in terms of the experience itself and the way it is perceived.

fun is a distraction from the self and pleasure is an immersion into the self, that fun is more likely to be associated with social interaction and pleasure is more likely to involve solitary activities, that fun is associated with a lack of seriousness while pleasure is associated with a deepening of the experience, that fun is a more superficial experience than pleasure, that fun is less likely to be associated than pleasure with a sense of achievement, and that fun is more closely related to the idea of play.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how people experience fun, how they talk about fun, how they make sense of fun and how this is reflected in the language they use to talk about fun.
the design and evaluation of experiences that people find enjoyable, and the design of systems that support and enhance those experiences.
the experience of pleasure and fun and the design of systems that support and enhance these experiences.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
fun is an enjoyable experience which distracts from the everyday, while pleasure is a rewarding experience that absorbs the everyday.
fun is a more playful, more active, more social and more distracting experience than pleasure.
fun is the experience of distraction, and pleasure the experience of absorption.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have tried to understand the semantics of fun, the ways in which people use the word fun and the ways in which the word fun is used.
the concept of fun is a broad and inclusive one, and that it is a concept that is used to express a variety of different types of enjoyment.
fun is a distraction from the everyday world, while pleasure is an immersion in it.
The main takeaway from our work is that
fun is not a unitary phenomenon, it has many different meanings and functions.
fun is a complex and multifaceted concept that is best approached from a number of different perspectives.
